queries_run: Eli Lilly China tariff OR trade restriction OR BIOSECURE 2026

findings.claim: Lilly 與美國政府的初步協議提供三年寬限期：Section 232 調查下的產品不課關稅，條件是達成美國製造投資承諾；定案協議仍在談判。
findings.excerpt: The preliminary agreements also provide a three-year grace period during which time our products under a Section 232 investigation will not face tariffs, provided that we meet U.S. manufacturing investment commitments. We are currently in the process of negotiating definitive agreements to implement these arrangements.

findings.claim: Lilly 依賴中國供應商取得部分供應鏈（化學合成、試劑、起始原料），美方持續考慮限制對中依賴（含 BIOSECURE Act），替代供應商可能不可行或耗時。
findings.excerpt: we, and the pharmaceutical industry generally, depend on China-based suppliers for portions of our supply chain, including integral chemical synthesis, reagents, starting materials, and ingredients. Finding alternative suppliers if and as necessary due to geopolitical developments or otherwise may not be feasible or could require significant time and expense

findings.claim: 公司稱藥品目前豁免部分關稅但豁免可能終止；若未來加徵關稅，可能無法有意義地分擔成本。
findings.excerpt: While pharmaceuticals are exempt from certain of these tariffs, such exemptions may be terminated or may not apply to any future tariffs.

findings.claim: Global Trade Alert：美國與 Lilly 的 MFN 定價協議含三年 Section 232 關稅豁免，實施日 2026-07-31。
findings.source: Global Trade Alert - Agreement with Eli Lilly on MFN drug pricing and tariff exemption
findings.excerpt: United States of America: Agreement with Eli Lilly on Most-Favoured-Nation drug pricing and tariff exemption Announcement 06 Nov 2025

findings.claim: 2026-04-02 公告對專利藥及成分課 100% Section 232 關稅，有協議者20%、EU/日/韓/瑞士15%。
findings.source: Supply Chain Dive - Trump tariffs patented drug imports
findings.excerpt: President Donald Trump is imposing a 100% tariff on patented pharmaceutical products and ingredients while also carving out reduced rates for certain goods and trade partners.

note: 出口管制／entity list 未另搜（本軸僅2次搜尋）；Section 232 100% 關稅 2026-07-31 對17家大藥廠生效、Lilly 適用稅率待核，見 clues。 線索 2 條，程式核實 2 條
